text: D6a-11 the room selection rule for form A, stated before any room is read. Candidates: form A's defining rooms whose distance to A's centre (the allocation's columns, _analysis/d4a08_embed.py, as D5 measured it) is at or below the first quartile of the defining rooms' distances (the nearest quarter: representative, not on the edge), and which lie nearer A's centre than any other form's. Rank the candidates by selected changes (the tree file's count of the room's changes against the global model), most first; then by coded concepts, most first; then by distance, nearest first. Take the first three. For each, report its distance, its rank by distance among the 135 defining rooms, and its selected changes. No room's record, lines or A1 telling is read before the three are chosen; the selection is by script.

D6a-11 three rooms of form A chosen by the logged rule (_analysis/d6a11_select_rooms.py; d6a11_select_A.json). First quartile of the 135 defining distances 0.8201 (median 0.8827); 31 candidates in the nearest quarter that lie nearer A's centre than any other. Chosen: r/FloydVsVoid (distance 0.690, rank 1 of 135 by distance, 26 selected changes, 205 coded concepts), r/prequelmemes (0.777, rank 13, 25 changes, 736 concepts), r/theexpanse (0.737, rank 5, 24 changes, 153 concepts); the form's defining median is 10 changes. Next in line: r/de (23), r/empiredidnothingwrong (20). r/FloydVsVoid was also D5's best fit and room read at length; the rule chose it again.

D6a-11 form A's telling and its three rooms written. out/form-telling-D6/: form-A.md (1,420 words) with form-A.png, .svg and .dot (the C5 drawing with A's 11 changed cells drawn by mark: none robust, 7 marginal, 4 size-dependent; P23 and C01 added; the change signature, Negotiated order 87 per cent at 1.75, Completion ritual 51 at 1.58, Standardization of output 37 at 2.06, from room-forms-D4a08c.jsonl, since a line-level count does not reproduce the allocation's columns); room-A-FloydVsVoid.md, room-A-prequelmemes.md and room-A-theexpanse.md (about 1,330 to 1,380 words each) with their .png, .svg and .dot, each laying the room's ops on every unit (_views/rooms-x-elements.tsv) and its selected changes (op:element at T3, T4, dimension) on the C5 drawing, the form's changes it shows outlined. Shown of form A's 11 changes: r/FloydVsVoid 5 (P04, P05, P08, P14, C01), r/prequelmemes 4 (P04, P05, P14, C01), r/theexpanse 4 (P23, P05, A05, P12). Change lines in the ledger view that are not among the selected changes are drawn apart and not counted. Moments cited from the A1 tellings (package/<sub>/case.md); every quotation checked against them by script. Script: _analysis/d6a11_form_telling.py (facts and graphviz sources), _analysis/d6a11_select_rooms.py; facts in _analysis/d6a11_facts_A.json. prose_check 0 after one quotation fix; 0 dashes or contractions; all r/ names analysed rooms in exact case.

D6a-11 closing. Form A's telling done; no data file, form or cut changed. Outputs in out/form-telling-D6/: form-A.md, .png, .svg, .dot; room-A-FloydVsVoid, room-A-prequelmemes and room-A-theexpanse, each .md, .png, .svg, .dot (figures checked: valid PNG and SVG). Correction of record to the line logged after the tellings were written: it said the prose check read 0 before the corrected form-A.md was rechecked; the recheck then read 0. notes-D6.md section D6a-11 (the D6a-10 close-check report, J's instruction, the selection rule and choice, what was written, the reading rules, what the marks do to form A, licences and slips). Head, Edits in two turns (written at D6a-11; Next: form B's telling): 3,000 words, at the limit; 0 dashes, contractions, 'serves as' or watch words; no proposition ids and no bare stage tokens; links.py all ids resolve. Checks read before this line: validate.py D6 0 errors, 0 warnings (d6a11_validate_D6.txt); no .pause. Next: done.sh D6 (a normal close).
